summary: Pampa Energía S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing a Material Event notice disclosing that its Board, at a November 2, 2026 meeting, approved amendments to existing compensation agreements with certain key executives. Terms include a gradual reduction in compensation once executives reach age 67, a progressive four-year reduction of technical and administrative duties, and an orderly transition of responsibilities; other changes are clarifying only. The Compensation Committee issued a favorable opinion. No price, stake, premium or closing date is stated. The item is an ordinary governance/compensation disclosure, not a special situation; no deal-risk angle applies.
